about.name: Kristóf Nyári
about.label: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
about.summary: I am a Cloud and DevOps Engineer who strives for innovation and excellence. I consider myself an innovator and a life-long learner. I have a quality and customer focused mindset. I am interested in Cloud Native applications, Automation and AI Agents.

highlights: Worked in an international cross-functional supporting team
Built and maintained a fully Cloud Native infrastructure hosting 20+ production microservices
Automated the lifecycle of the microservice applications (Build - Test - Deploy) via GitLab CI/CD
Optimized and secured Cloud Native applications which serve hundreds of customers including automation and identity management tools as well as databases.
Implemented a Cloud Native Monitoring and Alerting stack ensuring a first line of defense in case of outages, which helped in reducing the number of active alerts by ~90%
Worked with the Open Telekom Cloud that hosted our Highly Available Gardener Cluster
Key Technologies: Kubernetes, OTC, Gardener, ArgoCD, Prometheus & Grafana, IaC, GitLab CI/CD]
Worked on multiple projects with customer-facing roles in a cross-functional enabling team
Helped architect and implement a fully AWS native Data Mesh
Played a Key role in building and maintaining multiple Data Platforms that served hundreds of customers and enabled a modern way of data governance, ownership and collaboration
Ensured that the Highly Available Production Kubernetes cluster hosting said Data Platforms was reliable, working optimally and is cost-optimized.
Built Cloud Native ETL Pipelines via AWS CloudFormation enabling the smooth ingestion and processing of unstructured data, which evaluated to about 10 GBs per day
Ensured up-to-date Security Best Practices within Kubernetes Clusters and Public Cloud
Key Technologies: Kubernetes, AWS, IaC (CloudFormation), GitLab CI/CD]
Operated, maintained and upgraded production Linux servers
Optimized production Databases and Tables in MySQL
Implemented a Monitoring stack, namely Prometheus & Grafana
Created GitLab CI/CD Pipelines to automate repetitive tasks
Key Technologies: Linux, Databases, Monitoring tools, CI/CD tools
